malumbuddycards.gui.geas.pact_of_soul_pa:
Childish souls themselves form into packs.
 -Reaped Childish Spirits have a chance to become Malum or Mystery packs

Packs feel emptier than they used to be.
 -Packs contain three less cards than usual
 -Packs contain one less foil than usual
malumbuddycards.gui.geas.pact_of_the_bul: Is there ever too much of a good thing

Packs feel fuller than they used to be.
 -Packs contain three more cards than usual
 -Packs contain one more foil than usual

Something about them feels unlucky though.
 -Packs are considerably less likely to contain cards of higher rarity
 -Packs are considerably less likely to contain rare foil variants
malumbuddycards.gui.geas.pact_of_the_rai: The odds are what you make them

You see all the colors within your packs.
 -Your foil luck is tripled. increasing the chance for rainbow and luminis foil treatments.

Packs feel emptier than they used to be.
 -Packs contain three less cards than usual
malumbuddycards.gui.geas.pact_of_the_per:
Forget sleeves, you can grade cards with your eyes.
 -Up to two cards in your pack will come automatically graded.
 -Your grading luck is considerably increased.

Packs feel emptier than they used to be.
 -Packs contain three less cards than usual
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.childish_: Ever wanted to drain that childlike wonder out of annoying little brats? By making use of the properties of Buddysteel, now you can! That said, I can definitely find some good uses for their spirits.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.ring_of_y: I've been going through my childish spirits too fast lately. It takes time to find new victims, and the less I need to reap, the less I hear their screams at night. This should make gathering them more efficient.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.childish_: A bit of an odd choice, I'll admit, but once my collection grew large enough, the power of the medallions felt too strong to not take advantage of. By giving up my belt, I can easily wear three. Now just to find something new to hold up my pants.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.triplicat: I've been thinking about it, and with the current power of my medallions, I think they can compensate a lot of strength. I've altered the brooch so that I can handle the power of the medals myself, and the right medals can probably offset that cost.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.childish_: Childish arcana is not the most potent, yet is very chaotic and silly in nature. They aren't even that useful.

These childish spirits can be found within the most annoying of youth. It also is quite the nuisance to collect, needing specific trinkets to draw them out properly. It's probably not worth the trouble for those not interested in collecting Buddycards, but for those who are, I've found a few ways to use them to help in completing my collection.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.buddycard: For the collectors of Buddycards, you can create some unique packs with the usage of old cards, some paper to bind to, and a bunch of childish spirits. Once opened, the buddycards themselves are no different then other buddycards.
malum.gui.book.entry.page.text.rancid_sl: Some collectors may be crazy enough to want not just the best quality of Buddycards, but the worst of them as well. By infusing grading sleeves with the power of rotten essence, you can use these sleeves on already graded cards, and the value can only go down.
